_note: Reference map for the Douay-Rheims / Latin Vulgate Bible (e.g. the Project Gutenberg edition). Point config `reference_maps` at this file so its Latin/Catholic book names resolve to canonical OSIS books. The deuterocanon (Tobit, Judith, Wisdom, Sirach/Ecclesiasticus, Baruch, 1-2 Maccabees, …) is now first-class in the engine's canon, so those ingest whole. This map covers the remaining UNAMBIGUOUS Latin renamings. One thing it deliberately does NOT do — confirm it per document instead: the Vulgate Kings/Esdras shift (Douay '1-2 Kings' = Samuel, '3-4 Kings' = Kings; '1 Esdras' = Ezra, '2 Esdras' = Nehemiah) is a genuine cross-tradition divergence that would corrupt another edition if applied blindly. The `key_aliases` block is where you fold this edition's Vulgate Psalm numbering onto your canonical frame.

Revelation: Apocalypse of St. John the Apostle

key_aliases._note: Add versification remaps here if this edition's chapter:verse numbering diverges from your canonical frame (the Vulgate Psalms are numbered differently from the Hebrew for much of the Psalter). Format: {"bible:Ps.<this-edition>.<v>": "bible:Ps.<canonical>.<v>"}.
